description: This bar chart illustrates the morphosyntactic probing performance, measured as 'effect', across various language families and models. The horizontal axis represents the language categories, including 'IE-Romance', 'IE-Slavic family', 'IE-other', 'Isolate', 'Semitic', and 'Uralic', ordered from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled 'effect', uses a linear scale ranging from 10 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each category contains multiple bars representing different models: mBERT (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink), and XLM-B₂ (dark red), as indicated by the legend in the top right corner. The bars are grouped within each language family category, with each model's bar colored according to its type. The heights of the bars represent the effect values for each model, with error bars indicating variability. For example, in the 'IE-Slavic family' category, the tallest bar is for XLM-B₂ (dark red) at approximately 30, followed by mBERT-B₂ (light pink) at approximately 28, while the shortest bar in that group is for mBERT (light green) at approximately 15. The bars are not sorted by value but appear in the order of the language families listed. Some bars are visually emphasized with darker shading or outlines, particularly those with higher effect values, such as the dark red XLM-B₂ bar in the 'Semitic' category, which is the tallest bar in the chart at approximately 30.
